description: This file defines an enum called LaunchdManager that manages launching and stopping a process named 'OpenClaw' via launchctl commands. It includes methods for starting and stopping the process by invoking system commands.

classes.name: LaunchdManager
classes.description: An enum that provides static methods to control the launch of the OpenClaw application using launchctl.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: A private static method that executes the launchctl command with the given arguments.

methods.name: startOpenClaw
methods.description: Public method that constructs a launchctl command to start the OpenClaw process for the current user.

methods.name: stopOpenClaw
methods.description: Public method that constructs a launchctl command to stop the OpenClaw process for the current user.
